text:
QUOTE: if the approval callback is registered, `check_approval` sets `approved = true` after calling it... The header comment at `permission_manager.h:6` says "default-deny", but that default only holds when no callback is registered.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that when a callback is registered, an unmatched tool is approved and runs. It never concludes that the gate as a whole is default-ALLOW for tools on neither list, and it says the default-deny holds when no callback is registered.
